address: Plaza de la Lealtad 5, Madrid, 28014, Spain
bio: The Palm Court restaurant is located beneath an impressive glass dome in the elegant lobby of the Mandarín Oriental Ritz Madrid hotel. The à la carte here, which every lunchtime in winter is enhanced by delicious traditional-style dishes (on Thursdays, you can order the traditional “cocido madrileño”), includes options such as creamy rice with vegetables, glazed lamb shank with potato gratin, and a superb sole meunière....
